thesis: CDNA is in a strong uptrend (close 77.88 > SMA20 76.76 > SMA50 66.34 > SMA200 36.71) and is pulling back on fading volume (vol_ratio 0.63) toward the 75.81 post-earnings swing low after a 10/30 gap driven by Q3 revenue growth of 39.3%; pre-market 76.85 is inside the 76-78 zone. Healthcare leads in a risk-off tape, the balance sheet is strong and there is no visible binary or offering risk, so a small long on a hold of 76-78 targeting the 90.87 high gives asymmetric reward/risk (about 6.6 from 77.0). Confidence is low because the 74.9 stop is only about 0.4 ATR (5.19) from entry on a beta-2.49 name, so a stop-out before the target is more likely than not; news and SEC feeds were available.
invalidation: A daily close below 74.9, under the 75.81 swing low, breaks the pullback and opens the gap-fill toward 64.56-70.
key_risks: Stop is about 0.4 ATR from entry on a beta-2.49 stock, so whipsaw risk is high
Risk-off regime (QQQ below 50/200-day, ^TNX 1-year percentile 0.914) pressures high-multiple names
Growth is decelerating (YoY about 52% to 39.3%, QoQ 12.1% to 5.6%) with forward P/E 49.8 and EV/EBITDA 151
Q2 2026 net income of 110.6M looks one-off and the operating margin is 0.016, so earnings quality is uncertain
Short interest 13.9% of float adds reversal risk in both directions
Adds to a healthcare-heavy book, which may act as one correlated bet
